eventTypes.description: Types of events to which the subscription will listen.

destinationUrl.description: URL to which webhooks will be posted. Must be HTTPS on an IANA-listed top-level domain name (e.g. .com) with a path (at least /). No query parameters, userinfo, non-443 ports, or fragments allowed. We do not treat this field as sensitive data, so do not use secrets in this URL such as tokens or API keys.

secret.description: Secret string used to sign payloads sent to the destination URL.

orgId.description: Organization ID to be used for this operation. If unspecified, the Organization ID is inferred from the token. The token must have permission to interact with the organization.
